forbidden_rules.reason: Forced Open Team Sheets reveal moves, items and abilities; CTS needs Bo1 with sheets declined (ADR-003)

cts-invariant.description: With Open Team Sheets declined, Team Preview shows the opponent's species, level and gender only; the sheet is sent only after `>show-openteamsheets`. Tested in-process by `cts.test.ts` (#676); the server-path decline is #709.

damage-formula.description: Damage formula and rounding. These are covered by the calculator work, not by this pin.

freeze.description: Thaws after at most 3 turns, or 25% per turn

in-game-timer.description: Champions in-game timer values compared with Showdown's VGC Timer.

joint-legal-choices.description: Enumerated from the player's own request and judged by the pinned engine (ADR-006, `choices.ts`, `choice-judge.ts`). The golden choice corpus covers preview, every target type in the format's move pool, Mega, forced switches, conflicting switches, visible and hidden trapping, Imprison (`maybeDisabled`/`maybeLocked`), a fainted active with no replacement and a locked move; a brute-force oracle finds no engine-accepted action outside the enumerated set. `maybeLocked` is reached only with `maybeDisabled` (the engine derives one from the other outside gen 1), so the Imprison case covers both. The oracle leaves out engine auto-choice (`default`), which ADR-006 never offers. Unverified: no in-game fixture yet.

mega-request-shape.description: The engine offers `canMegaEvo` on a Mega Stone holder and accepts Mega on one slot per choice, never both (golden choice corpus `mega`, `mega-both`). `canMegaEvoX`/`canMegaEvoY` exist only in other mods (`gen7letsgo`, `monkeyspaw`), never in Reg M-C: Charizard X and Y are separate stones. Revisit if a supported format's mod defines them.

move-item-ability-overrides.description: 257 move, 253 item and 15 ability overrides of the Gen 9 data (count: `grep -c $'^\t[a-z0-9]*: {' <file>`)

open-team-sheets.description: Opt-in in Bo1 (`Open Team Sheets`), forced in Bo3. Areneon supports Bo1 only and declines.

override-parity.description: Whether every Champions move, item and ability override matches the game. No in-game fixtures exist yet.

pokepaste.description: `Teams.import` reads Stat Points from the `EVs:` line and silently skips lines it does not know (an `SPs:` line leaves every Stat Point at 0). A repeated line overwrites the earlier one. Areneon's `importPaste` rejects a paste unless each Pokémon's lines all reappear in that Pokémon's re-export, so it accepts only the engine's canonical form (reordered stats, `Level: 100`, `IVs: 31`, a lowercase or misspelt species or a teambuilder header are rejected; revisit if hand-written or third-party pastes become an input path). Team legality messages are logged in `fixtures/teams/<format>/verdicts.json`.

pp.description: Max PP is `(pp / 5 + 1) * 4`; base PP above 20 is capped to 20

sleep.description: Lasts 2 or 3 turns (1/3 chance to wake on turn 2)

stat-points.description: The set's `evs` field holds Stat Points. Stats at level 50 are `base + SP + 20` (HP `base + SP + 75`), then the nature applies. The validator rejects a set with 0 Stat Points under Serious (it suggests another neutral nature if that was intended).

terastallization.description: Not offered in Reg M-C: the champions mod's `canTerastallize` returns null, so no request carries `canTerastallize` (golden fixtures and choice corpus). The enumerator still emits `terastallize` (one per side) when a request offers it; that path has unit tests only. Revisit when a supported format allows Terastallization.

timer.description: Showdown `VGC Timer`: 90 s preview, 420 s bank, 55 s per turn, auto-choose on timeout. This is a server rule; the in-process sim does not run it.
